title: Digital Public Infrastructure and Sovereign AI Stack
prelims_pointers: India Stack includes Aadhaar, UPI, and DigiLocker as foundational open API layers.
Ministry of Electronics and IT (MeitY) serves as the nodal agency for National AI Mission implementation.

mains_perspective.context: Expanding DPI architecture beyond financial technology into healthcare, agriculture, and AI capabilities.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Democratizes access to digital services while promoting domestic innovation and reducing dependence on proprietary global stacks.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Implement robust data protection frameworks and expand broadband connectivity across Tier-2 and rural sectors.

title: Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture & Agriculture Policy Directions
prelims_pointers: Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture is organized annually by All India Radio (Prasar Bharati).
Focuses on policy frameworks for sustainable agricultural growth and farmer welfare.

mains_perspective.context: Evaluating structural changes required in agricultural supply chains and price stabilization mechanisms.
mains_perspective.key_arguments: Need to transition towards high-value agriculture, micro-irrigation, and climate-resilient seed technologies.
mains_perspective.way_forward: Strengthen Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) and scale up modern storage infrastructure.
